title: WOMBO COMBO
blurb: Cracking-voiced, absolutely unhinged commentary from a Super Smash Bros. Melee tournament, and by most reckonings the original hype meme of competitive gaming. Its sincerity is what keeps it alive. Nobody was performing for an audience; the shouting is simply what happens when something impossible occurs in front of people who understand exactly how impossible it is. Play it when anything chains together perfectly: a combo, a plan, a sequence of events that had no business working and did anyway. Nearly two decades on, it still carries the whole room.
origin: From the legendary Super Smash Bros. Melee 'Wombo Combo' clip.
